description: This file sets up a FastAPI web application with WebSocket support, serving an HTML page that allows users to connect via WebSocket, send messages, and receive responses. It includes WebSocket route handling, dependency injection for cookies and query parameters, and a basic client-side script for WebSocket interaction.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: Main application class for serving HTTP and WebSocket endpoints.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Handles GET request for the root path, serving an HTML page with WebSocket client.

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None, token: Annotated[str | None, Query()] = None, )
methods.description: Dependency that extracts session cookie or token from WebSocket request, raising exception if neither is provided.

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( *, websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: int | None = None, cookie_or_token: Annotated[str, Depends(get_cookie_or_token)], )
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connections at /items/{item_id}/ws, echoes messages and sends session/token info.
